$comment: SERVICE-LEVEL OBJECTIVES for the CI pipeline, as DATA.
These existed only as prose in a planning document, which meant the SLI report computed
success rates and p95 durations and compared them to nothing. A measurement with no objective
attached to it cannot be missed: the number could double and no artifact anywhere would say so.
Encoded here rather than as literals in eng/ci/ci-sli-report.py so that changing what we promise
is a reviewable edit to a policy file, not a code change buried in a formatting function.
THREE VERDICTS, NOT TWO. An objective is MET, MISSED, or UNMEASURABLE, and the third is not a
polite form of the second. MISSED means we measured and fell short. UNMEASURABLE means no
number exists to compare -- the window was empty, or the pipeline does not produce the quantity
the objective names. Collapsing them would let a workflow that stopped running entirely report
the same verdict as one that is merely slow, and those have opposite fixes.
An objective with metric: null is unmeasurable BY CONSTRUCTION and must carry an
unmeasurable-because explaining what is missing. It is kept in this file on purpose: an
objective we cannot yet evaluate is a known gap, and deleting it would turn a gap into a
silence.
FIELDS
id                    stable identifier, used in the history series
description           what is promised, in words
workflow              the workflow file the objective is about
metric                key produced by the SLI summariser, or null if not produced at all
comparison            at-most | at-least
value, unit           the threshold and how to print it

objectives.description: Required PR validation completes within 20 minutes at p95
The official build succeeds at least 95% of the time
PR preflight completes within 5 minutes at p95
objectives.unmeasurable-because: No workflow in this repository is designated 'PR preflight'. Fifteen workflows trigger on pull_request, so any single one chosen here would be an assumption reported as a measurement. Name the preflight workflow to make this objective evaluable.

objectives.description: Fewer than 2% of runs are rerun because of infrastructure, not product failures
objectives.unmeasurable-because: The pipeline records THAT a run was reattempted but not WHY, so infrastructure-induced reruns cannot be separated from reruns of genuine product failures. The rerun rate is reported in the indicator table and is deliberately NOT compared against this objective: it counts a strictly larger population, and scoring it here would report a different quantity under this objective's name.
